posts.title: What I am doing about climate change
posts.description: It has been a hot summer, with quite a few heatwaves pushing past 30°C. I am not an environmental campaigner, but the weather is increasingly making me think we need to take better care of our planet. This post is about the levers I already have: who I bank with, who supplies my energy, who represents me in Parliament, and the company I work for. posts.title: GitOps with Flux on my k3s cluster
posts.description: I already knew how to put things on a Kubernetes cluster. Helm packages the YAML. kubectl apply makes it exist. cert-manager mints the certificates. What I did not have was a boring answer to “what happens next week, when I have forgotten which laptop I ran that from?” GitOps is that answer, at least for platform on my homelab.
